title: Affinity Maturation
description: In a germinal centre, antibody genes are mutated on purpose and the cells that bind best are kept, round after round: evolution inside the body, in days. Unlocks the Clonal Selector, Matured Antibodies, and the Metastasis Ward that sees through immune evasion.

puzzle.goal: Each round of selection multiplies how tightly an antibody binds by (1 + s). Write the gain A after n rounds.
puzzle.name: Affinity growth
puzzle.ask: Find A for s = 0.3 and n = @{n}.
puzzle.method: The gains multiply, round on round: (1 + s)·(1 + s)·... n times. Affinity grows exponentially while the clones last.
